title: Evaluating groundwater quality in an arsenic-contaminated aquifer in the Red River Delta using machine learning: a case study in Van Phuc, Hanoi, Vietnam
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1027-1038
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00368G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thi Duyen Vu, Thanh Dam Nguyen, Thi Kim Trang Pham, Michael Berg, Hung Viet Pham
XGBoost-based machine learning applied to hydrogeochemical indicators shows that groundwater in Van Phuc's arsenic-contaminated aquifer is predominantly poor to marginal quality and is controlled by redox-driven hydrogeochemical zonation.
